scene: Your tap releases iridescent smoke, pointing toward three busy transport hubs.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of a bustling transit deck. Far left, a spiral bronze lift with open gates stands ready. Left, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat watches glowing vapour curl upward. Centre, a wooden mountain cable tram waits by turnstiles. Far right, a glass-roofed trolley rests on rails.
shown: a winding bronze lift tower with open grille gates on the far left
a wooden cable tram resting at an open turnstile in the centre
a sleek trolley with a curved glass roof waiting on the far right
